requests.title: A new visual encounter
requests.reason: The world has grown past its current visual baseline.

requests.title: A room that can contain the new scale

requests.title: Material evidence
requests.reason: The next state needs a concrete external or visual reference.

rule: A fulfilled need becomes a return event and becomes eligible to trigger the next need. The system should prefer concrete media/artifacts over abstract status messages.
